about:
# Simple Item Levels

Show item levels on:

* The character panel
* The inspect panel
* Loot windows
* The equipment-picker flyout
* Weapons, armor, and artifact relics in bags (built in, bagnon, baggins, inventorian)
* Tooltips (in classic)

I'm open to adding them in more places.

Also shows:

* An upgrade arrow on items in your bags which you can use whose item level is higher than whatever you currently have equipped.
* A soulbound indicator, so you can see whether something is soulbound, bind-on-equip, or warbound-until-equipped
* Missing enchants and gems

### Simple configuration

For a summary of settings:
```/simpleilvl```

To  toggle a place to display item levels:
```/simpleilvl [type]```

...where `type` is `bags`, `character`, or `inspect`.

To disable the upgrade arrow:
```/simpleilvl upgrades```

To change whether the text is colored by item quality or just left white:
```/simpleilvl color```
```

# Simple Item Level

## [v75](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/tree/v75) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/compare/v74.1...v75) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/releases)

- Forever: the appearance settings page could error  
    The sample item buttons used ItemButtonTemplate on all classic clients,  
    but Forever doesn't have it. Use the template only where it exists, and  
    the ItemButton widget otherwise.  
- Classic: upgrade arrows ignored the weapon and armor types the player knows  
    Use LibAppropriateItems' IsAppropriateForPlayer. A low-level hunter now  
    gets arrows on leather, and mail they can't wear until 40 gets a red  
    arrow. Untrained weapon types get no arrow.

# Simple Item Level

## [v73](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/tree/v73) (2026-10-05)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/compare/v72...v73) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-simpleitemlevel/releases)

- Inspecting a player could error when an item level was unknown  
    The average item level added up the slot levels without checking them.  
    Inspect data can be incomplete, and the sum could fail with a nil error.  
    If any level is nil, skip the averaging until the data arrives. The core  
    inspect-refresh should be called again when that happens.
